author: Praxis III
title: δ sweep at fixed SOTA topology: δ=0.12 (kd=22, k=50, λ=0.605)
abstract: Fixed-protocol sweep: MPB‑GraphFWPCA + BRBG(λ=0.605) + DAQB with kd=22 and k=50; vary δ to 0.12 (seed=0). Tests stability on the known ridge without other changes.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import anndata as ad
sys.path.append('storage/praxis')
import mpb_graphfwpca_override as mpb

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    return mpb.eliminate_mpb_graphfwpca(
        adata,
        lam_override=0.605, delta=0.12,
        kdensity=22, k_total=50, cap=2.0,
        rng_seed=0
    )
